title: Round execution span
statement: For a $k$-tape configuration $c$ over Boolean work symbols and states in $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$, an action $a$ of the same machine, two configurations $d,e$ of the compiled machine with $k+2$ work tapes, and a time $T\in\mathbb{N}$, the round-span condition holds when the compiled round machine started at $d$ reaches $e$ after exactly $T$ steps, and at every time $u<T$ its state is neither the entry state nor the halt state and its configuration satisfies the round-window condition determined by $c$ and $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a $k$-tape configuration over Boolean symbols and states in $\text{Fin}(n+1)$ on input $x$
$a$ is an action over the same symbols and states
$d,e$ are compiled configurations with $k+2$ work tapes on input $x$
caveat: The snippet does not define the round machine, the entry and halt encodings, or the round-window condition, so their precise meanings cannot be given from the supplied material.
